<DOCSTRING>
Divides `a` by `b` and returns the result. Throws an error if `b` is zero, ensuring the divisor is not zero.

@param {number} a - Dividend to divide.
@param {number} b - Divisor to divide by; must not be zero.
@throws {Error} If `b` is zero, indicating division by zero is not allowed.</DOCSTRING>
